emails.snippet: please find attached the last company report
emails.message:
Hi Katie,

Please find attached the last company report for Q3 regional enterprise sales. We exceeded our target margin by 14.2% across Midwest retail sectors.

Key highlights:
- Enterprise ACV grew to $482k
- Sales cycle shortened from 42 days to 28 days
- Client retention reached 96.8%

Let me know your availability for a follow-up review on Tuesday.

Best regards,
Bowen Hank
VP of Global Sales Operations
